TorrServer MatriX.147.2 (separate optional streaming process)

Official corresponding source for the exact bundled binaries:
https://github.com/YouROK/TorrServer/tree/MatriX.147.2
https://github.com/YouROK/TorrServer/archive/refs/tags/MatriX.147.2.tar.gz

The pinned checksums and original release URLs are in scripts/prepare-torrent-engine.cjs.
The Windows build embeds GStreamer; its runtime and component license files are
extracted by TorrServer alongside its runtime. Preserve these notices when redistributing.
Lumen communicates with this separate process over its loopback HTTP API.
